value.name: keeps mother's memory in car
value.description: Before leaving the car, Asha lingers because she does not want to leave her mother's memory alone in the empty car at midnight.
evidence: she did not want to leave her mother's summer face alone in an empty car at midnight

value.name: exits car with briefcase
value.description: Asha gets out of the car holding the briefcase and stands in the cold parking lot.
evidence: Asha got out of the car with the briefcase in her hand and stood a moment in the cold of the lot

value.name: tightens grip and walks to porch
value.description: Asha tightens her grip on the briefcase and walks toward the porch light, her shoes loud on the wet asphalt.
evidence: She tightened her grip on the handle until the leather creaked, then walked toward the porch light, her shoes loud on the wet asphalt

value.name: pauses at steps
value.description: At the bottom of the steps, Asha pauses and touches the painted railing before going up.
evidence: At the bottom of the steps she paused and laid her free hand flat on the painted railing, feeling the grit under her palm, and she stayed there a breath longer than she needed to before she went up

value.name: rings doorbell
value.description: Asha rings the doorbell once and lets her hand fall, still carrying the briefcase.
evidence: She rang the bell once, evenly, and let her hand fall back to her side, the briefcase brushing her knee like a thing she had forgotten she was still carrying

value.name: meets unfamiliar aide at door
value.description: The door opens to an unfamiliar night aide instead of Rosa, signaling that Asha is not being greeted by the person she expected.
evidence: The door opened slowly, the way Rosa might have opened it, except it was a night aide Asha didn't recognize

value.name: reads aide's guarded expression
value.description: Asha notices the aide's carefully neutral expression, which suggests withheld news or concern for the family.
evidence: her face arranged into the careful neutrality people wore when they had already decided how much to tell a family member at the door

value.name: enters house uninvited
value.description: Asha steps inside the house before being invited, driven by her need to avoid waiting on the porch.
evidence: Asha registered the warm hallway smell behind her—floor cleaner, something baked earlier, the faint medicinal undertone she had stopped noticing months ago—and stepped inside before she was invited, because waiting any longer on the porch would have undone whatever she had braced for in the car

value.name: sets briefcase down inside
value.description: Just inside the entry, Asha deliberately sets the briefcase against the wainscoting.
evidence: Just past the entry mat she set the briefcase down against the wainscoting, deliberately
